label: kizuna_rival_b_01
text: So you’re good for a battle, right? Great! Meet\nyou at the schoolyard in a minute?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_mob_01
text: Uhhh, hold up—you’re Nemona, right? Like, the\nstudent council president? That Nemona?

label: kizuna_rival_b_mob_02
text: Ah hah hah...hah. Yeeeah. Maybe some\nother time.

label: kizuna_rival_b_04
text: Oh, him? Dunno who he was![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_05
text: I was just munching my sandwich and I heard him\nbragging about his tough Pokémon, so I invited\r\nhim to battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_06
text: I wonder what Pokémon he’s gonna use?\nCan’t wait to see![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_07
text: Wait, I forgot to get his contact info! How are we\nsupposed to plan when we’ll face off?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_08
text: Oh well. I’ll make sure we battle next time I run\ninto him![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_09
text: Anyway, guess you came to get some grub, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_b_10
text: Well, I’m not one to stand between someone\nand their meal! Catch you later![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
